name: alibaba/wan/2.5/image-to-image
description: Alibaba Wan 2.5 image-to-image model that edits one or more input images from a natural-language instruction, with selectable output aspect ratio.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Random seed for reproducibility. If None, a random seed is chosen.

images.title: Images
images.description: URLs of images to edit. For single-image editing, provide 1 URL. For multi-reference generation, provide up to 2 URLs. If more than 2 URLs are provided, only the first 2 will be used.

prompt.title: Prompt
examples: Reimagine the scene under a raging thunderstorm at night: lightning forks across the sky, illuminating the samurai in stark flashes of white light.
prompt.description: The text prompt describing how to edit the image. Max 2000 characters.

aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio
aspect_ratio.description: The aspect ratio of the generated image.

id.description: Unique identifier for the generation task.

error.description: Error message if the task failed. Empty on success.

model.description: Model ID used for the prediction.

status.description: Status of the task: pending, running, completed, failed, or timeout.

url.description: The URL where the generated content can be downloaded from.

content_type.description: The MIME type of the output file.

outputs.description: Array of generated content. Empty when status is not completed.

input.prompt: Reimagine the scene under a raging thunderstorm at night: lightning forks across the sky, illuminating the samurai in stark flashes of white light.

readme:
# Wan 2.5 Image to Image

Wan 2.5 image editing: send one or more pictures and describe the change.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string, required | — | Text instruction. |
| `images` | image URL[], required | — | Images to edit or combine, Image 1, Image 2, … |
| `aspect_ratio` | `21:9` / `16:9` / `3:2` / `4:3` / `5:4` / `1:1` / `4:5` / `3:4` / `2:3` / `9:16` | — | Omit to follow the first input image. |
| `seed` | integer | random | Fix it to compare prompt changes. |

## Billing

$0.05 per output image. Input images are not metered.

| Request | Price |
|---|---|
| One image | $0.05 |

Failed runs are not charged.

## Prompting

- State the change and what must stay the same.

## Limits

- One output image per request. Wan 2.7 is newer and cheaper.

## Also on SandBase

Other Wan 2.5 endpoints: `alibaba/wan/2.5/text-to-video`, `alibaba/wan/2.5/image-to-video`, `alibaba/wan/2.5/text-to-image`, `alibaba/wan/2.7/image-to-image` (newer).
